import pytest


def shout(xs: list[str]) -> None:
    """Print every string upper-cased on its own line."""
    for s in xs:
        print(s.upper())


def test_shout_empty(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    shout([])
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == ""


def test_shout_words(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    shout(["hello", "world"])
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "HELLO\nWORLD\n"


def test_shout_mixed_cases(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    shout(["Python 3.12", "Already UPPER", ""])
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "PYTHON 3.12\nALREADY UPPER\n\n"
